label: forced-guard-counterexample
command:
import t2pw.rag.loop_policy as lp
s = lp.LoopState(rounds_completed=3, max_rounds=3, now=100.0, deadline=1000.0,
                 round_retrieval_completed=True, ladder_completed=True,
                 new_admissible_claims=2, graph_delta=2)
shipped = lp._conditions(s)
print('state: ceiling reached, 900 s of clock left, ladder_completed=True, new_admissible_claims=2')
print('AS SHIPPED   (guard = not exhausted)      ->', lp.decide(s).reason, '| continue =', lp.decide(s).should_continue)
alt = dict(shipped)
alt[lp.ROUND_CAP_REACHED] = s.round_cap_reached and not s.ladder_completed
held = [r for r in lp.TERMINATION_PRECEDENCE if alt[r]]
print('IF GUARDED LIKE D-024 (not ladder_completed) -> reasons held:', held, '| continue =', not held)
print('out_of_budget for this state:', s.out_of_budget)
assert lp.decide(s).reason == lp.ROUND_CAP_REACHED and lp.decide(s).should_continue is False
assert held == [], 'the counterexample does not hold -- the comment would be FALSE'
assert s.out_of_budget is True
print('CONFIRMED: the alternative guard yields NO reason on a state that reached a bound == unbounded loop')
